name: Whippoorwill Piranha Swarm
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

perception.note: Low light vision, Scent 100ft imprecise, blood scent

generalAbilities.name: Blood Scent
generalAbilities.description: The piranha swarm can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.

defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feeding Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Each enemy in the swarm's space takes (2d6-2) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save).

A creature that fails the save also takes 1d6 Bleed Damage and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to their Reflex saves against Feeding Frenzy while this damage continues, as the piranhas' frenzy increases in intensity when they smell blood.
